title: Which theme a default-wallpaper answer belongs to is a session field, not part of the request
trigger: Set a wallpaper for the light theme and, before its answer, one for the dark theme (or the reverse).
effect: set_default_background(_local) writes chats_state.background_set_for_dark; the Background answer reads it at arrival, so the first answer is stored under the second request's theme.
fix: Carry for_dark_theme in RequestPurpose::SetDefaultBackground{for_dark}.

title: set_privacy_rules mirrors the new value into calls.privacy_allow_calls/privacy_p2p at send time; the error handler never reverts the mirror
trigger: Privacy > Calls or Peer-to-peer: change the rule, TDLib rejects setUserPrivacySettingRules.
effect: PrivacyKeyState becomes Failed (previous rule lost) but the calls mirror keeps the rejected value, so the Calls tab and call code show a rule the server does not have.
fix: Keep the confirmed rule in PrivacyKeyState::Saving{confirmed, wanted}; mirror only on ok and restore confirmed on error.

title: refresh_notification_sounds_if_stale: an answer already in flight clears saved_sounds_stale, so the later change is never refetched
trigger: A getSavedNotificationSounds request is in flight; updateSavedNotificationSounds arrives (stale=true); the in-flight answer (older data) lands.
effect: apply sets saved_sounds_loaded=true and saved_sounds_stale=false on the old answer; the sound list stays old until the next update.
fix: Stamp the list with a generation; the stale mark outlives answers sent before it.

title: resolve_notification_sound registers pending_sound_downloads/sound_file_ids before download_file, whose result is ignored
trigger: Play a custom notification sound whose file is not local while download_file fails to send (path inactive).
effect: The sound id stays in pending_sound_downloads; a later unrelated completion of the file plays the sound unexpectedly.
fix: Insert the pending marker only when download_file returns Ok, and remove it on Err.

title: confirm_device_login sets sessions_mutating before the answer and relies on the answer to clear it; a dropped continuation leaves device login and session terminates blocked
trigger: Scan a login QR, confirm; TDLib never answers (connection drop with the request lost).
effect: sessions_mutating stays true, terminate/toggle/confirm all return InvalidRequest until restart.
fix: Hold Mutating{request} and clear it when that request is dropped (reconnect/account reset).

title: set_less_data_for_calls and set_storage_limits send several requests and return on the first send error, leaving networks or options half applied
trigger: Toggle 'Use less data for calls' when the second send fails.
effect: Network 1 is sent (applied on ok), networks 2 and 3 are not; the toggle shows a mix with no retry.
fix: Queue the set as one step list in an enum (like ManagerCommit) with a single outcome.

title: ToneUpload::Uploading has no exit when the answer is lost, and blocks every later upload
trigger: Upload a notification sound; the connection drops and the request is dropped without an answer.
effect: tone_upload stays Uploading; upload_notification_tone refuses all further files until restart.
fix: Clear Uploading when its request is dropped (reconnect or account reset).

title: A deleted string in updateLanguagePackStrings clears the key to English, dropping the base pack and community overlay layers
trigger: Using a pack with a base pack or a Quill community overlay; Telegram deletes one of its strings (patched with Deleted).
effect: That string shows in English (or empty fall-through) instead of the base pack's/overlay's text until the pack is reloaded.
fix: Keep layers separate (overlay, base, pack) and recompute the key from the lower layers on delete.

title: Notification bursts coalesce by chat only, so forum topics merge
trigger: A forum supergroup gets a message in topic A then one in topic B before the queue drains
effect: One toast reading 'N new messages'; the inline reply target message_id is the newest message, in topic B, and the first topic's title/body is lost
fix: Key the queue by (chat, topic) using the ChatMessage/topic owner key.

title: A failed first dictionary load is cached forever in OnceLock<Option<..>>
trigger: Dictionary file is briefly unreadable (antivirus lock, being replaced) when the engine first checks a word.
effect: That language's words are never flagged (is_correct returns true when nothing loaded) until the engine is rebuilt by changing languages or restarting.
fix: Entry stage enum Unloaded / Loaded(dict) / Failed(retry after) instead of a permanent None.

title: Each hunspell_engine build starts a warm thread that keeps parsing after the engine was replaced
trigger: Switch spelling languages several times quickly with large dictionaries.
effect: Several threads parse dictionaries nobody uses (the Arc keeps the backend alive) until done; wasted CPU and memory.
fix: Give warm a cancel token owned by the SpellEngine, set on drop.

title: A cancel pressed after the last chunk is ignored: install still runs and the language is switched on
trigger: Click the switch off right as the second file finishes.
effect: Dictionary is installed and enabled although the user cancelled; Err("Cancelled.") only returned if the flag was set before the install call.
fix: Make Cancelling a stage that the completion arm checks before set_spell_languages.

title: is_correct inserts a backend answer after a concurrent clear_cache, so a stale verdict outlives a learn/unlearn
trigger: Background re-check is in is_correct (backend call) while the user picks Add to Dictionary on a macOS-system-learned word; the check then inserts its old false.
effect: Word added to the system dictionary stays underlined until another cache clear.
fix: Tag the cache with a generation counter bumped by clear_cache and drop inserts from an older generation.

title: updateLanguagePackStrings for the pack being switched to is dropped
trigger: Switch language; while the new pack's strings are fetched the server pushes a change to that pack.
effect: UpdateStrings compares with state.current (the old pack) and returns, so the fetched snapshot misses that change until the next full reload.
fix: Also match switching.info.id and queue the patch on the switch, applying it when the switch becomes ready.

title: One shared privacy_data.error is cleared by unrelated successes and overwritten by unrelated failures
trigger: Change the inactive-session timeout and let it fail (error line set), then open Network usage which loads fine (apply_privacy_data_payload clears error at line 103).
effect: The timeout failure line vanishes without the user fixing anything; a later failure of another setting replaces it.
fix: Keep one error per control (Fetch/Save enum per setting) rather than a shared Option<String>.

title: Deleting a custom theme that fails on disk still switches the app away from it
trigger: Settings > Appearance, select a custom theme, press Delete when the file cannot be removed (read-only themes folder, permission error).
effect: delete_custom_theme shows the error toast but still resets the day/night slot to the built-in default, so the theme is unapplied while its tile (re-read from the folder) is still there.
fix: Reset the slots only when store::delete returned Ok.

title: Renaming a custom theme in the editor deletes the old file but leaves the other day/night slot naming it
trigger: Have custom theme 'Mine' (light) as the day theme; Edit it, change it to dark colours and rename it 'Mine2'; Save.
effect: save_theme_editor deletes 'Mine' and choose_app_theme puts 'Mine2' in the night slot only; the day slot still names the deleted 'Mine', so in day mode Quill silently falls back to the default theme (delete_custom_theme clears such slots, the rename path does not).
fix: On a rename, repoint every slot that named the old theme to the new name (or reset it), the same way delete_custom_theme does.

title: Each refresh_system_accent while a Linux read is pending starts another 100 ms poll loop
trigger: With 'use system accent' on, on Linux, switch to Quill repeatedly (window activation) while the gdbus/gsettings read is still running (up to the desktop query time limit)
effect: Several identical 100 ms poll tasks run at once, each re-applying the appearance when the read lands; wasted wakes, no wrong state
fix: Keep the poll as one stored Task (e.g. `accent_poll: Option<Task<()>>`) and skip starting a second while it is set.

title: HISTORY_AREA thread-local is shared by all windows and never cleared
trigger: Main window and a chat window both show outgoing gradient bubbles with different sizes, or a history without wallpaper layer paints after another window.
effect: note_history_area stores the last painted history's bounds; a bubble in another window (or a frame where the wallpaper layer did not report) slices its gradient from that stale area, so colours differ from what the window's own area gives.
fix: Key the area by window/history (pass it through the paint context) or clear it at the start of each frame.

title: fire_resize takes the resize callback out while it runs so a nested set_zoom skips relayout
trigger: Change the interface scale twice while GPUI is inside the resize callback (e.g. from a deferred settings update)
effect: The inner relayout is silently skipped; window keeps the old scale until next real resize
fix: Queue a pending zoom re-fire (enum Idle/Running/RunAgain) instead of skipping

title: Badge pref is applied to the session before it is saved
trigger: Toggle a badge switch while the account dir cannot be written.
effect: The session value changes and a silent note says the save failed; the switch shows the new value until restart, when the old one returns.
fix: Apply after a successful save, or show the failure as an error and revert.

title: Mute panel reopens with a sound picker still expanded
trigger: Header Mute > Change (story sound) > pick a mute preset or press X; open Mute again, on this or another chat.
effect: close_mute_menu clears notif_sound_picker_open but never story_sound_picker_open, open_mute_menu clears neither, and apply_chat_mute clears none of the picker flags, so the pickers open from the last visit show for the new chat.
fix: Reset the whole panel value on open (see the MutePanel enum).

title: Mute box closes as if saved when setChatNotificationSettings failed
trigger: Press a mute preset while the driver refuses the request.
effect: apply_chat_mute sets mute_menu_open = false and mute_chat = None before sending, so on Err the box is already gone and only a status note says it failed; the choice must be redone from scratch.
fix: Close in the Ok arm only.

title: Custom mute fields keep the last duration when the panel opens straight on Custom
trigger: Mute a chat for 3 days via Custom, then open a chat row's menu > Mute custom for another chat.
effect: open_mute_menu_for(custom = true) calls queue_mute_time_inputs, which returns at once when mute_time already exists; only the Custom toggle button resets the fields, so the new box shows 3 days instead of the 8 hour default.
fix: Reset the fields whenever the panel opens (part of the open value), not only on the toggle.

title: Sound picker closes before the setting is applied or even attempted
trigger: Defaults dialog: choose a sound while the scope/reaction settings are still loading, or the send fails.
effect: apply_scope_sound, apply_reaction_sound (and apply_chat_sound, apply_chat_story_sound) clear the picker flag first; the 'still loading' return and the Err note leave the picker closed with the old sound.
fix: Close the picker in the Ok arm only.

title: A file dialog answered after the passcode lock still starts the upload
trigger: Pick Upload Sound, leave the file dialog open, let auto-lock engage, choose the file.
effect: The spawn_screen continuation calls begin_tone_upload with no refused_while_locked or wait_for_unlock check, so the upload goes out and the picked sound is applied under the lock.
fix: Queue the pick as an unlock intent (wait_for_unlock) like the other OS opens.

title: Upload target is lost on an account switch while the upload goes on
trigger: Upload a sound from the picker, switch accounts before it lands, switch back.
effect: tone_upload_target lives in NotifyUi (replaced by the switch) but the upload outcome stays in the old account's session; on return settle_tone_upload sees Added with target None and only toasts, the new sound is not selected.
fix: Put the target inside ToneUpload::Uploading in the session so the two cannot separate.

title: Delete saved sound ignores the result and has no confirmation
trigger: Right-click a saved sound > Delete while the request fails.
effect: remove_notification_tone's Err is dropped with let _ =; no note, the row stays and the user cannot tell whether it worked.
fix: Show the error as a status note (and confirm like tdesktop).

title: Block and exception pickers say 'No more contacts' while the contacts are still being fetched
trigger: Privacy > Block... (or Add user in an exception list) before contacts are loaded.
effect: contact_rows() is empty until fetch_contacts answers, so the picker shows the empty-state text instead of a loading state.
fix: Show Fetch::Loading for the contacts list in the picker.

title: The 'No' note of the phone-number prompt is never reset
trigger: In Settings > Account answer 'No' to 'Is +X still your number?', later answer Yes (or let TDLib drop the suggestion), then get the suggestion again in the same session.
effect: settings.phone_change_note stays true for the life of the account's OnScreen, so the explanation is already open the next time the prompt appears. Nothing clears it when the suggestion goes away.
fix: Make the prompt a small enum (Asking, NotMine) owned by the suggestion, reset when the suggestion leaves chat_list.suggestions.actions.

title: How many activity rows show is app-wide and never resets
trigger: Press Show more several times, change a filter or pick another account, or leave the page and return.
effect: Another account or filter opens with an enlarged page of rows (up to hundreds drawn at once); only Clear resets it.
fix: Move the paging count into AgentPageUi next to the filter, reset in leave_agent_page and when the filter or picked account changes.

title: Add-a-chat picker is rebuilt only when the chat count or granted ids change
trigger: A chat is renamed, or one chat leaves and another joins between renders so the count stays the same, while Agent access is open.
effect: The picker lists stale titles or misses the new chat until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Key the picker on a session revision counter for the chat list, or derive the item list on each open of the menu instead of caching it.

title: Narrow-window back from a page keeps the search Arrival alive, with its animation tick
trigger: Narrow window: open a search result so Arrival is set and its row has been painted, then press the back arrow before the next render has centered it. settings_back sets page = None without clearing arrival; landed stays None so the timeout never starts.
effect: settle_arrival requests an animation tick at 60 fps for the rest of the Settings visit and the wash never ends. Needs a very fast click, so unlikely.
fix: Clear arrival in leave_settings_page (the one place a page is left); make Arrival one enum Seeking / Landed(Instant) / Done.

title: Opening a search result for the page already shown leaves the page but skips its arrival work
trigger: On Settings > Devices (or Data and storage, Notifications) search for a setting of the same page and open it. open_search_target calls leave_settings_page, then show_settings_page returns early in switch_settings_page because the page is unchanged.
effect: The page's drafts are dropped (open session details, storage editor, confirm banner) but the arrival step (fetch_sessions, arrive_data_storage, fetch_notification_settings) does not run, so error lines and the guarded fetch of the visit are skipped.
fix: Treat leave plus arrive as one reset step run for a same-page result as well, or skip the leave when the page is unchanged.

title: Dictionary rows list the dictionary folder from disk on every render
trigger: Open Manage dictionaries; during a download render runs every 120 ms. dictionary_rows calls installed_codes(&dir) each time.
effect: Disk reads on the UI thread every frame while the list is open.
fix: Cache the installed codes and refresh them on download or remove.

title: Switching on a second dictionary while one downloads does nothing and says nothing
trigger: Switch on a language, and while it downloads switch on another. start_dictionary_download returns when download.is_some(); the switch draws from row state so it snaps back.
effect: The click is lost without a note.
fix: Queue the second request or show a note.

title: Cancel is recognised by comparing the error text to "Cancelled."
trigger: Any future change to the string in spell_download turns a cancel into a red failure row.
effect: A user cancel shows as a failed download with an error line.
fix: Return an enum DownloadError::{Cancelled, Message(String)} from download_dictionary.

title: remove_dictionary updates the chosen list even when removing the files failed
trigger: Remove a downloaded dictionary whose file is locked or read-only.
effect: Toast says it could not remove, but the language is dropped from the picked list; if that empties the list the engine silently goes to automatic locale languages.
fix: Return early after the error note; only change the chosen list when remove succeeded.

title: Turning spell check on does not check drafts already in the composers
trigger: Turn Check spelling off, type a draft, turn it on again. sync_spellcheck clears misspellings while disabled and nothing re-checks when the setting changes (new_accent_picker.rs:512 only sets the pref).
effect: No underlines until the next edit in each window.
fix: Call recheck_spelling from the setter.

title: Slot::Preview is one slot for every preview area in every window, so two previews replace each other's render forever
trigger: Open the chat wallpaper box (ChatLook) in a chat window and the wallpaper preview in the main window (or any two chat_look_preview areas of different size at once).
effect: Each frame one area's request replaces the other's queued/running job (replaces=true) with a 150 ms settle delay, so neither renders and both keep requesting animation frames.
fix: Hash the window id (and the owning dialog) into the preview slot as History does, or give each preview area its own slot key.

title: A pattern or photo that failed to read is remembered as None, and its fill-only result is cached under the same key
trigger: A pattern file read fails once (e.g. replaced while TDLib rewrites it) while its chat is open.
effect: remember() keeps the None, and the Cache entry for that (wallpaper,size) key holds the fill-only/empty picture, so the pattern/photo never appears until another wallpaper evicts it or the size changes.
fix: Do not remember failures (or remember them with a retry time), and do not cache a degraded render under the final key.
